narration: [chintu] <bookmark mark='chintu'/>A vertical fold makes a flat crease, because the paper moves up when I fold it.
<bookmark mark='look'/>Look at the crease itself, not at the way the paper moves. It stands upright.
<bookmark mark='strike'/>We name the fold by its crease line, so an upright crease is not a flat one.
